scene_summary: An orange, an onion, an egg and some garlic sit on a shelf under a clock.
notes: French elision, in both directions. Seven of these take l' before a vowel or mute h, but bean is le haricot -- the h is aspirated and the article does not elide. A model that has learned 'vowel means l'' gets that one wrong, and it is the single most common French article error.
